name: FIBRA Macquarie México
summary: FIBRA Macquarie México (FIBRA Macquarie) is a real estate investment trust targeting industrial, retail and office real estate opportunities in Mexico, with a primary focus on stabilized income-producing properties. FIBRA Macquarie's portfolio consists of 246 industrial properties and 17 retail properties, located in 20 cities across 16 Mexican states as of September 30, 2026. Nine of the retail properties are held through a 50/50 joint venture. FIBRA Macquarie México was incorporated on November 14th, 2012 in Mexico.
